name: Annie O'Donnell
bio: Annie O'Donnell started her acting career landing roles in such films as the Richard Benjamin comedy "Saturday the 14th" (1981), the Clint Eastwood action flick "Heartbreak Ridge" (1986) and the Diane Keaton dramedy "Baby Boom" (1987). She also appeared in the action movie "Easy Wheels" (1989) with Paul Le Mat, the comedy "Homer and Eddie" (1989) with James Belushi and the action film "Kickboxer 2" (1991) with Sasha Mitchell. She continued to work steadily in film throughout the nineties, appearing in the comedy "Black Sheep" (1996) with Chris Farley, "Born Bad" (1998) and the dramatic comedy "The Players Club" (1998) with Ice Cube. She also appeared in "Blast From the Past" (1999) with Brendan Fraser.
